user.description:
Hungary based Hard Techno / Schranz Producer, DJ, Mixing & Mastering Engineer
Contact: thotteofficial@gmail.com

Thotte’s journey into electronic music began in his teenage years, when he was drawn into rave culture and the raw energy of 1990s electronic music. The rebellious spirit, intensity, and freedom of that era still shape his sound today. One of his strongest influences is The Prodigy, not only musically but in attitude — aggressive, instinctive, and uncompromising.

Producing music since 2012, Thotte has explored a wide range of styles before ultimately finding his home in schranz — the sound that truly reflects who he is. Fast tempos, industrial pressure, distorted grooves and relentless energy define both his productions and DJ sets.

His music blends 2000s hardtechno with the anarchic mindset of ’90s rave culture. This is not about nostalgia or trends, but about authenticity and roots. Sets are built with precision and intent, gradually evolving into controlled chaos that takes over the dancefloor.

Beyond the booth, Thotte is the founder and manager of the Eternal Resurrection label, a platform dedicated to uncompromising underground hardtechno. His work has also been released on respected labels such as DSR Digital, Pure Hate, Second Air, Echo Audio, and Awesome Beats, further cementing his place within the international hard techno underground.

As a DJ and producer, Thotte represents the underground ethos in its purest form. His sound is not made for background listening — it is meant to be felt physically, by those who seek intensity, honesty, and full-volume release.

@eternalresurrection
